Standalone Module Preservation Figure

Source: R/stat_module_preservation.R
cliplot_module_preservation.Rd

High-level wrapper to plot cross-network module preservation results.

Usage

cliplot_module_preservation(data, ...)

Arguments

data

Data frame returned by cli_module_preservation or containing size and z_summary columns.

...

Additional styling arguments passed to type_module_preservation.

Value

A ggplot object.
